title: Anyone using AI for DeFi strategy research instead of price predictions?
author: Moist-Impress-7323
selftext:
I’m more interested in using AI to compare DeFi strategies from external data than having it guess where BTC goes next.

Say you want yield on USDC, no leverage, and the ability to exit quickly. Could it pull lending rates, liquidity and protocol data, then compare realistic options instead of just ranking APYs?

For anyone actually doing this: what breaks first,  data quality, risk assessment, or execution costs?

Curious what sources you use and how you check whether a suggested strategy actually makes sense.
